class.name: OrderIndependentTransparencyCompositorEffect
class.description: Implements weighted-blended order-independent transparency (McGuire/Bavoil) entirely inside a [CompositorEffect] using the public [RenderingDevice] API. On Forward+ the callback runs at [constant CompositorEffect.EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_PRE_TRANSPARENT]; on Mobile projects should switch to [constant CompositorEffect.EFFECT_CALLBACK_TYPE_POST_TRANSPARENT]. The effect issues a two-attachment accumulate pass over transparent batches followed by a fullscreen composite blit with (ONE, ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA) blending. Reverse-Z depth reject is used when sampling the resolved scene depth so occluded fragments are dropped before the weight function runs. Geometry batches are supplied through the [signal OrderIndependentTransparencyGeometryRelay.transparency_batches_ready] signal (Path A) or, in a future engine hook, directly by the renderer.

method.name: _on_batches_ready
method.description: Slot for the geometry relay's transparency_batches_ready signal. Not intended for direct invocation.

members.member: Multiplier applied to the composite output. The POC uses [code]0.5[/code] for LDR framebuffers and [code]1.0[/code] for HDR to compensate for the weighted-blended saturation curve.
Enables the [code]USE_MSAA[/code] variant of the composite shader for per-sample resolve. Not supported on all drivers; falls back to non-MSAA with a warn-once.
Precision of the accum render target. HDR uses [code]R16G16B16A16_SFLOAT[/code]; LDR uses [code]R8G8B8A8_UNORM[/code].
Tuning knob that scales the weighted-blended weight-function denominator. Projects with more transparent overlap should raise this value.

When [code]true[/code], performs a fenced async readback of the accum texture every N frames and emits [signal order_independent_transparency_stats] with peak alpha-weight saturation and revealage extremes.

signal.name: order_independent_transparency_stats
signal.description: Emitted when the debug overlay has new stats. Only fires while [member debug_overlay_enabled] is [code]true[/code].
